summary: Corvex, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Seth Demsey as co-Chief Executive Officer effective July 1, 2026, following the company's annual meeting. This appointment was previously disclosed and is pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement dated March 19, 2026, under which Corvex acquired Corvex OpCo. Demsey, age 49, has served on the board since the merger and was co-CEO and co-founder of Corvex OpCo. No departure of a prior CEO was detailed; Demsey joins alongside existing co-CEO Jay Crystal.
